summary: Adopted repository-native agent memory with a current-state summary, JSONL events and decision records.
reason: Agents share one OpenCode harness and working tree. A service or vector database would add concurrency and operational surface before there is evidence it is needed.
decisions: The parent agent is the single memory writer; subagents return handoffs.
Events are append-only context, while Git and fresh test output remain authoritative.
Commit is nullable while the worktree is dirty; worktree_state records the condition.
Do not add a vector database or memory service until search size or concurrent top-level writers require it.

summary: Word Search now gives one hint per puzzle instead of three. After the hint the button is disabled; Restart keeps the hint spent and keeps its ring on the board; a new puzzle starts with its one hint. The how-to text and the hint line describe the new limit.
reason: The user asked for only one hint per game in Word Search.
decisions: HINTS is 1 in word-search/game.js.
The hint belongs to the puzzle, not the attempt: restart() no longer resets hinted or hintsLeft, so a player cannot restart to farm another hint on the same board.
start() still resets the hint (hinted and hintsLeft) because it starts a new puzzle; the resume path derives hintsLeft from the saved hinted set, so a refresh keeps the hint spent.
The hint ring stays visible after Restart, since it is information about the same puzzle and the hint has already been paid for.

summary: Fixed the Flow Free board clipping its bottom row in Safari/WebKit by replacing .ff-inner height:100% with height:auto and aspect-ratio:1/1.
reason: In WebKit, .ff-inner resolved 100% against the board's border box rather than its content box because .ff-board uses aspect-ratio and border-box sizing. The grid became 20px taller than the board, and overflow:hidden cut off the bottom row.
decisions: Keep .ff-board as the square border-box tray and size .ff-inner with width:100%, height:auto and aspect-ratio:1/1 so the grid matches the content box in Chromium and WebKit.
